Defeated in war, the Crown Prince offered Erendil as tribute to the “Monster Prince” of a neighboring kingdom. Facing the humiliation of being sold to a monster, Erendil chose to end his own life. However, perhaps through divine pity, he was miraculously granted a second chance. This time, he vowed not to repeat the mistakes of his past.
As Erendil prepared to escape, a suspicious man, a salesman of adult novelties, appeared before him….
“Being the Crown Princess doesn’t change anything. As I said, I’m not that kind of frivolous man.”

115027.synopsis:
Jiang Xianchuan was reborn and went back to 15 days before the apocalypse.
He was planning to stock up on supplies with his friends and stay at home, but he didn’t expect that he had superpowers.
“Is it my turn to get the male protagonist script this time?”
Thinking of his inexplicable tragic death last time, Jiang Xianchuan vowed to live well in this life
associated_names: 重生扭轉：末世喪屍我想活！

116051.synopsis:
【System + Food + Ensemble Cast + Comfort Food + Light Daily Life】
Chen Ran, who lost her sense of taste and was kicked out of her home, obtained the Chef God system. As long as she works various jobs, she can restore her taste and learn stronger cooking skills.
Such a great deal—let’s go!
【Kindergarten Job】
Not only did the kids’ appetites improve, but even the parents started eating better.
More than two hundred months-old kids occasionally tasted the kindergarten meals and voluntarily joined the kitchen internship.
What? You say you want to borrow our kid just to try the kindergarten food?
【Police Station Job】
Ever since Chef Chen joined the kitchen, overtime complaints dropped, and officers felt happier on duty.
Even prisoners’ mouths opened more easily.
Wait, you want to confess? Really? But the chef’s off today… Wait! Confessions can’t be taken back!
【Hired by a Variety Show Crew】
It’s supposed to be a celebrity-centered cooking show, so why is everyone eyeing the staff meals?
Wait, that’s the staff lunchbox, Your Majesty!
Why is there someone sneaking around the kitchen? Turns out the singing king is stealing lunchboxes!
The drooling on the livestream was all acting; stealing lunchboxes after wrap-up is the real deal!
Every time Chen Ran works, her cooking attracts foodies like crazy.
As the youngest top star on the Chef List, other chefs can pay to reserve or even buy spots from scalpers, but only her dishes are impossible to try without luck.
Kids sneak into kindergarten, people sneak in to work secretly, even disguise themselves as staff.
Just when everyone finally gets in, someone finds out the chef has moved on to another job!

118611.synopsis:
Lin Xuan was reincarnated—into a matriarchal world of magic.
He has long, holy silver hair, a white flower growing over his right eye, and flawless, exquisitely beautiful features—his appearance is nothing short of breathtaking.
Yet, he is about to be auctioned off as a s*ave to the nobility.
Just as fate seems sealed, he is rescued by a fated female lord.
At first, he thinks he will now live a calm and peaceful life… but then he discovers that the current Pope is actually his “mother”…
And so, a twist of fate unfolds…

121171.synopsis:
How do you become a favored imperial consort?
Noble birth? Proper education? Gentle and courteous?
Unfortunately, Nan Jin has none of those.
Her strengths include—but are not limited to—acting, scheming, manipulation, fighting tooth and nail, and wanting it all.
In just three years in the palace, with exceptional tea-making skills, beauty, and wit, Nan Jin managed to lure the emperor like a hooked fish and rose from a lowly palace maid whose life was worth less than grass to become the emperor’s most cherished consort.
The other consorts hated her to the bone and used the vilest words to describe her:
“You’re cunning, ruthless, and will stop at nothing!”
Nan Jin merely raised a delicate brow and accepted it all with grace:
“Thank you, sister, for the praise. I humbly accept it.
At first, when facing the cold and distant Emperor Shen Yanci, Nan Jin thought:
‘Justice in this world has always been in the hands of those in power. Then I shall become the one in power and tilt justice toward myself.’
‘He is the only road I have to ascend to the clouds.’
Later, faced with the now passionate Shen Yanci, Nan Jin played hard to get with a charming smile.
“Heh, the emperor?”
“Playing him is as easy as training a dog~”

I’m the type that looks great when I take my glasses off.

125011.synopsis:
[Military Marriage in a Military Compound + Villainous Supporting Role + Successful Turnaround + Doted-on by Her In-Laws] 
Medical PhD Lin Wanjun transmigrated into a melodramatic military marriage novel set in the 1970s—and landed straight into the role of the villainess everyone wanted to slap. Faced with a disastrous start, Lin Wanjun made one thing clear: she refused to accept her so-called fate.
What? The villainess is a brainless younger-brother-worshipper? Then the first thing she’ll do is beat up her whole “family,” snatch back the betrothal gifts and her spatial ring.
What? The villainess cheated and got divorced? Then she’s going to cling tightly to her officer husband, take her magical storage ring, and accompany him to the countryside reformation while feasting and living it up in secret.
She’d originally planned to lie low, wait for the storm to pass, then divorce and run off with the spatial ring. But the tall, broad-shouldered, devastatingly handsome male lead suddenly veered off-script—dumping the original female lead and relentlessly pursuing Lin Wanjun instead.
“Junjun, my darling, you are my heart, my liver, three-fourths of my very life.”
Lin Wanjun: gags …Wait, hold on—there was never a storyline about the villainess having triplets in the original plot! Somebody save me!
associated_names: 穿书七零，手握空间搬空供销社

130387.synopsis:
Jiang Yao has suffered from autism since childhood.
Like a plant – quiet, well-behaved, showing no interest in anything, never expressing pain.
His parents worried constantly, taking him everywhere seeking medical help, but saw little improvement.
They raised him with such careful attention.
One day when he was 20, he suddenly disappeared.
Jiang Yao was missing for exactly one year. His family and police exhausted all resources but could never find his whereabouts.
A year later, he appeared at their doorstep in tattered clothes.
There was blood on him. But the DNA didn’t belong to him.
After mysteriously disappearing and mysteriously reappearing, Jiang Yao had lost all memories of that year.
But suddenly, he was willing to speak.
He could cry, laugh, and express “I want.”
Though still quiet, he now resembled a normal person.
His parents wept with joy, asking how he became willing to communicate.
Looking in the mirror, Jiang Yao said:
“There’s a voice in my heart that constantly tells me the world is beautiful, urging me to live well.”
That voice in his heart always accompanied and encouraged him.
Even when he was caught up in strange incidents, it would gently tell him:
“Close your eyes, let me handle this.”
Jiang Yao trusted that voice unconditionally.
So when foul-smelling, sticky fish-people grabbed his ankles to drag him into the deep sea, when pale, skeletal corpses cornered him at a cliff edge.
He would obediently close his eyes.
Count in his mind: one, two, three.
Count to one hundred, open his eyes, and find nothing but scattered, broken corpses around him.
While he himself stood before a thicket of thorns.
Holding in his hand the most beautiful rose.
Jiang Yao always thought he merely had a mental illness that created a second personality.
Until one day, he passed by a high-end custom suit shop.
He, who never wore suits, unconsciously caressed the smooth, soft premium fabric.
In that instant, he recalled the sensation of sweat-dampened skin nestled in someone’s embrace.
—So he had once had a lover.
“I want to go back, back to the deepest, darkest abyss.”
“To find you.”
One-line summary: After being caught up in strange incidents, I discovered there’s someone in my heart
Theme: Always maintain human moral boundaries no matter the circumstances

131923.synopsis:
Ji Myeong-hyeon, who died at the age of 50 after slipping on an icy road.
 He is reincarnated with memories of his past life.
One day, after living a fulfilling life thanks to the parents he never had before,
“Student, have you ever thought about becoming an idol?”
He gets street-cast by an agency.
 Seeing that this reality, unlike his previous life, actually gives him a higher-than-lottery chance of success, he decides to debut as an idol.
And that idol group is none other than “YEARZ,” which included Baek Jae-heon—his former colleague’s favorite idol and ultimate bias.
BL Guide
Setting/Genre: Modern setting, Reincarnation/Regression, Entertainment Industry
Tags: Gentle-yet-strong uke, capable uke, neat uke, handsome seme, beautiful seme, big-dog seme, obsessive seme, devoted seme
Uke (Bottom): Ji Cheonmyeong(Ji Myeong-hyeon) – A 50-year-old lifelong bachelor who dies and is reincarnated. Unlike his boring previous life, this time he challenges himself to become an idol. Having lived a combined 68 years, he has good judgment. However, he is clumsy when it comes to emotions he is experiencing for the first time.
Gong (Top): Baek Jae-heon – A beautiful man shrouded in mystery, whose thoughts are impossible to read. He is the visual of the same idol group as the uke, possessing a kind of flawless perfection that feels like that of a seasoned newcomer.
When to Read: When you want to enjoy idols and also want a reincarnation/regression story with a touch of pure romance.
Relatable Quote: “The switch for emotions that had never worked once in my life has finally turned on.”

132435.synopsis:
“Doeon… you have to… protect the mansion… in my place…”
Seo Doeon has been caring for his sick mother, completely cut off from the world. Left alone with her dying wish to protect the mansion, in front of Doeon appear his father, Seo Taeoh, who left after divorcing his mother 19 years ago, and his younger sibling, Seo Doha.
Though they are family, for Doeon—who has spent his whole life hiding that he is a dominant Omega and pretending to be a Beta—the dominant Alphas before him are nothing but strangers…
“How about staying with us for a while?”
Thus begins a strange cohabitation. But suspicion that they might try to take the mansion, his mother’s inheritance, makes Doeon increasingly anxious. To make matters worse, Doha discovers a trait that Doeon has been hiding…
“Seeing that you’re reacting to my pheromones, you really are an Omega. And since your pheromones are faint, you must be a dominant one. Too bad, hyung.”
A single mistake quickly turns their already fragile relationship sour.
“You’re the only Omega in our family.”
Inside the mansion, cut off from the world, unfolds a twisted obsession among the three. What will collapse first—the mansion, or Doeon’s heart?

149843.synopsis:
“You’re just an orphan, yet you call yourself the First Saint. Who do you think you are? A woman like you is not fit to be my fiance, the Crown Prince!”
My fiancee, who had scolded me, was holding a beautiful woman in his arms.
It’s not like I’ve ever called myself the First Saint before…
After my engagement was annulled in the middle of a ball, I was ordered by the king to marry a man known as the “Lecherous Marquis.”
However, without even looking at me, the marquis, my future husband, declared:
“I have no choice but to marry you because it’s the king’s command, but I will never love you.”
“We get along well. I also have no choice but to come here because it’s the king’s command.”
“Huh?”
I had never expected to be loved, so I took advantage of this opportunity and enjoyed a free life.
I was spending each day happily with my cute stepson and servants, who had grown attached to me… when, what?
My husband, who had declared, “I will never love you,” was looking at me, wanting to become a friend!?
Meanwhile, my ex-fiance, who had dumped me, was hit by a series of events that made him regret breaking off the engagement.
associated_names: 捨てられ聖女は契約結婚を満喫中。後悔してる？だから何？
